mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 4.0% and unemployment rate rises exceeding 0.2 percentage points signal monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers positive 20-day returns in over 60% of triggered instances, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1800 thousand units signal a housing market expansion that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1800, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly payroll growth exceeding 100k net new jobs indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by >100k, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1600 thousand units for two consecutive months signals housing sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1600 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts combined with rising real personal consumption expenditures signals sector rotation from durable to non-durable goods, creating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to earnings volatility.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers positive 20-day returns in over 60% of triggered instances, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation exceeding 3.0% year-over-year signals high inflation that prompts Federal Reserve rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
